_provenance: Synthetic, NOT a recording: the roster is invented, its shape is not.
Shape built at kami-lens 1.0.0 (0ffc8a7) from the daemon's own sources,
no daemon queried: data matches src/queries/schemas/roster.json (the
account block's levelUpReady and skillPoints have been required since
lens 0.5.0 and were missing here), and meta has exactly the keys, in
the order, src/queries/envelope.ts builds: servedAt, blockNumber,
stale, mode, reconciledThrough, appliedThrough, asOf (block,
projectedAtSec and the four clock-sample fields of a live daemon).
incompleteRows and suppressed are absent, as on an answer with no
incomplete row and nothing withheld.
Re-checked at kami-lens 1.0.2 (62c3d85), unchanged: roster.json and
the meta keys envelope.ts builds are identical to 1.0.0's (1.0.1 and
1.0.2 changed status, inventory and the projected amounts of kami,
party and node, none of which the brief carries); from 1.0.2
asOf.clockSampleAgoMs may run past 300000 on a healthy daemon.
SERVED FORM: from 0.6.0 the brief is a harness tool, and the harness's
MCP server (FastMCP) serializes a dict result with indent=2. That is
what reaches the model, so envelope_chars and kami_chars_each are
measured on it, and the recorded-surface fake serves it. Through
0.6.0 this fixture was measured, and served, compactly — about half
the bytes a real session carried — so smoke floors quoted before
0.7.0 understate the brief term and do not compare.
Roster size is the one free parameter and the brief's context cost is
linear in it: envelope_chars and kami_chars_each convert a floor
measured here to any other roster, and KAMI_SMOKE_BRIEF_KAMIS
re-measures it directly.
